notes.title: Surprise! We're releasing early!!
notes.content: Hey everyone!  Our official Steam release date got moved up from March 22nd to ...well... NOW!  So please enjoy another FREE release from Pinhead Games!  If ya like it, please let us know by leaving us a review.  And don't forget to stream, we love love LOVE Let's Players!
